source: https://github.com/intel-iot-devkit/sample-videos (person-bicycle-car-detection.mp4), scaled to 640x360 and re-encoded to H.264
description: High oblique fixed camera over a car park; 54 s, 640x360 @ 12 fps. Two cars drive through towards the upper left; two cyclists ride left to right; pedestrians walk through (must not be counted).
